title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street
description: Life is anything but normal for Gortimer and his two best friends, Ranger and Mel, as they navigate Normal Street – an ordinary suburb that has a hint of something magical just beneath the surface.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x1
episodes_data.description: An Amazon Original Pilot: Life is anything but normal for Gortimer and his two best friends, Ranger and Mel, as they navigate Normal Street - an ordinary suburb that has a hint of something magical just beneath the surface. We'd love to know what you thought of this show. Tell us at AmazonOriginals.com.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x2
episodes_data.description: While trying to help the unluckiest kid on Normal Street, Gortimer accidentally jinxes himself with bad luck. Now Gortimer, Mel and Ranger must find a way to set things straight before a wave of misfortune threatens Normal Street's annual Road Rocket Race.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x3
episodes_data.description: When Mel worries that her rival is the frontrunner for this year's school science fair, she scrambles to build a project that will blow everyone away.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x4
episodes_data.description: When Gortimer learns a piece of information he would rather forget, he seeks help from an incredibly chipper but incredibly memory-impaired resident of Normal Street.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x5
episodes_data.description: The gang races to restore Gortimer's voice, stolen by a mysterious figure driving a ghostly bookmobile that appears on Normal Street for only one day each year.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x6
episodes_data.description: Shortly after the students elect Mel the president of the student council, she is dethroned after the unlikely Ranger proves himself to be the stuff of legend and becomes The Once and Future Student Council President.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x7
episodes_data.description: Gortimer keeps having the same strange dream about a frightening underwater encounter -- and his mounting fears are getting in the way of his junior lifeguard training.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x8
episodes_data.description: To celebrate a rare astronomical event, Mel invites all her friends to a spooky sleepover, complete with ghost stories galore. But when it seems like an actual spirit has crashed the party, they all must hurry to solve the mystery before they become ghost stories themselves.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x9
episodes_data.description: After Ranger accidentally causes havoc at his family's bakery, he flees the scene to avoid getting into trouble, but his growing sense of guilt has an unusual effect.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x10
episodes_data.description: When Mel starts consulting a children's fortune teller game for advice on the future, she finds herself attempting to outsmart fate.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x11
episodes_data.description: Gortimer's curiosity is piqued when he discovers a mysterious signature. Is it the autograph of a new student at Normal Middle school... or has it been here all along?

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x12
episodes_data.description: On the eve of his 13th birthday, Ranger and Mel lead Gortimer on a scavenger hunt through town to find the fabled lost treasure of Normal Street.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 1x13
episodes_data.description: With his Dad in town for a short visit, Gortimer goes out of his way to ensure his happiness doesn't fade by creating a rainbow over Normal Street. But once all of the residents start acting unusually happy, Mel and Ranger wonder if he's gone a step too far.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x1
episodes_data.description: Gortimer gets a blazer that makes everyone see him as an adult. It changes the way he sees himself too and threatens his friends' plans for an epic water balloon battle.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x2
episodes_data.description: Ranger gets swept up in the celebrity of being the good luck charm of the basketball team, whose lucky head-rubs cause unnatural levels of static electricity.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x3
episodes_data.description: Mel and Abigail use a new photo software for the yearbook which accidentally erases Gortimer's smile. As they struggle to restore Gortimer, their budding friendship is tested.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x4
episodes_data.description: Ranger's childhood imaginary friend comes back to visit, much to the chagrin of Gortimer.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x5
episodes_data.description: Gortimer is haunted by the sound of a mysterious violin, which interferes with his studies and his sleep. Gortimer realizes he can't hide the truth about his slipping grades from his Biologist Dad.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x6
episodes_data.description: Amid the backdrop of Normal Days -- a celebration of the founding of Normal Street -- Mel discovers a shocking secret about the town's founder Captain Normal.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x7
episodes_data.description: Gortimer and his mom's new boyfriend Adam warm up their chilly relationship with a magical friendship "Bro-celet."

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x8
episodes_data.description: While studying for an important test, Mel's brain fills to capacity.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x9
episodes_data.description: Stanley gets a magical tattoo, and suddenly everyone takes him seriously -- too seriously.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x10
episodes_data.description: Gortimer has to babysit on the same night that he has a "date" with Abigail. He finds a solution when he clones himself, but the solution quickly becomes a problem.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x11
episodes_data.description: Ranger brings Mel and a heartbroken Gortimer on a quest to find a fabled flower of Normal Street for his Grandpa, who has an unexpected health scare.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x12
episodes_data.description: In the wake of Lora's death, Mel tries to build a time machine to go back in time and save her mom. But Future Mel arrives to dissuade Mel from her mission.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x13
episodes_data.description: The trio goes camping and shares a perfect moment that distracts them from all their recent troubles. Will a wish on a star make the moment continue?

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x14
episodes_data.description: As a new year arrives on Normal Street, Gortimer resolves to find a new interest so he can keep up with his multi-talented friends. But when he stumbles upon a magical deck of cards that can make him an expert in any skill he desires, he begins to question his true self.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x15
episodes_data.description: At a pivotal moment for the Bowen family, Ranger learns his dad is plagued by an arch nemesis from his youth. Tired of seeing his dad live in Rob's shadow, Ranger takes matters into his own hands.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x16
episodes_data.description: When the student ID card machine malfunctions, Gortimer, Mel, Ranger, and Catherine swap identities. As they walk a mile in each other's shoes, will they gain a new perspective on the friends they thought they knew so well?

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x17
episodes_data.description: When Mel starts seeing a mysterious horse everywhere she goes, Ranger warns it's the legendary, much feared Night Mare of Normal Street. In order to rid herself of the nightmares, Mel must overcome her greatest fear.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x18
episodes_data.description: The gang takes part in a 1920s-themed mystery party and wind up stuck in their characters' personas. When a valuable antique goes missing, it's up to Gortimer to solve the mystery and bring his friends back to normal.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x19
episodes_data.description: When family issues weigh on Ranger, his pals encourage him to talk it out at the peer counseling center. But once there, Ranger instead opts to be a peer counselor himself. And as more and more students confide in him, Ranger finds the weight of the world upon his shoulders.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x20
episodes_data.description: When work and family duties begin to overwhelm Claire, Gortimer reassures her with a special surprise gift: a "World's Best Mom" mug. But after just a few sips from it, Claire is transformed into a "super mom", but at what cost?

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x21
episodes_data.description: After Mel falls sick from stretching herself too thin, she returns to school only to find that her friends and teachers don't seem to remember her.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x22
episodes_data.description: After receiving some bombshell news, Gortimer escapes to the comfort of his favorite TV show, the campy '60s superhero series, "Adventures of White Hat." But once an inter-dimensional transporter gets involved, Gortimer takes his escapism to a new level.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x23
episodes_data.description: As the gang prepares a surprise birthday party for Gortimer, they take turns making video recordings of the weird, wild and wonderful stories of their adventures with Gortimer.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x24
episodes_data.description: As the Normal Formal approaches, Gortimer decides it's finally time to ask Abigail to the dance. But when Stanley happens upon a mysterious love potion and starts playing Cupid Gortimer's plans unravel.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x25
episodes_data.description: After Gortimer receives some devastating news that could separate him from the people he loves the most, Normal Street is beset by a puzzling series of earthquakes. The kids rush to find the source of the tremors before Normal Street literally gets torn apart.

episodes_data.title: Gortimer Gibbon’s Life on Normal Street 2x26
episodes_data.description: The trio decides to gather all the special items from their old adventures and place them safely in a time capsule. But as they accumulate mementos of their past, doubts set in about their future.
